name: @papercusp/sse
description: Spec-compliant Server-Sent Events primitives — server response builder, in-process channel bus, PG NOTIFY bridge, resilient EventSource client, React hook.

scripts.build: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { existsSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = require('node:fs'); rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); const result = spawnSync(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'tsc.cmd' : 'tsc', ['-p', 'tsconfig.json'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const exitCode = result.status ?? 1; const emitted = existsSync('dist/index.js'); if (emitted) writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }, null, 2) + '\\n'); else console.error('ERROR: tsc did not emit dist/index.js; refusing to write dist/package.json'); process.exit(emitted ? exitCode : (exitCode || 1))"
